Brokerage Governance

System Version: OS v1.1 | Effective: Aug 19, 2026

1. Operating Model

DigiiState operates as a Digital Real Estate Infrastructure provider. We own, develop, and maintain high-performance digital territories (assets) and lease the rights to exclusive inbound demand generated by these assets to qualified business partners.

2. Asset Integrity

Each territory is represented by a "Digital Deed." We guarantee 100% exclusivity for leased assets within their specified geographic and industry parameters. No two partners shall ever receive the same lead flow from a single DigiiState asset.

3. Data Transparency

Our "Abundant Clarity" protocol ensures that all lead data, call recordings, and search engine rankings are accessible to partners via their dedicated Partner Portals. All performance metrics are reconciled daily against authoritative production records.

"Stability is the foundation for scale. We govern our digital properties with the same rigor as institutional physical real estate."
